dct_description_sm: Soil microbial community structure is being characterised using PCR-DGGE and deep pyrosequencing for bacteria, fungi and archaea in exposed heath ecosystems at several scales (within the Daring Lake site, and among similar sites across the Arctic).  Our goal is to characterise variation in community structure and to investigate whether such variation could significantly influence biogeochemical responses to changes in temperature.
dct_title_s: The influence of soil microbial communities on carbon and nutrient cycling in heath tundra across the Arctic
